sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Release page Cover art section: each thumbnail has a hover card (types as pills, comment, a 500 px preview, "6 of 16 · Liner 1 of 4", edit and archive id), built from the archive record already loaded and shown by the shared tooltip engine — so it is skipped on a tap like every other card. Type chips above the sheet (All, then each type in archive order, with counts) show only the images carrying that type; an image with two types counts for and shows under both. A Grid / By type switch groups the sheet under each image's first type; the choice is remembered (GM key mb_sa_release_art_layout) and carried by the config export's workspace block.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Release page Cover art section: a thumbnail that fails to load (the archive was down on 2026-10-06) no longer collapses its tile and spills its alt text over the next one — the tile is now a fixed square box that clips. The sheet is capped at the window width, so a release whose tracklist is wider than the window (many relationship columns, or a phone) no longer lays every tile out in one long row.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Specs: release-tracks-cover-art.spec.js grows to 14 tests (chips, layout, remembered layout, hover card, square tile on a failed thumbnail); new release-tracks-cover-art.mobile.spec.js (a tap shows no card; the sheet fits the window); config-workspace-roundtrip.spec.js covers the new workspace key.
